events.name: Ferry to Saltreach
events.failText: The ferryman holds out a hand. "A hundred gold, friends. The sea is long."
events.text: The ferry carries you north across the bay to Saltreach.

events.name: Desert Gate
events.text: Beyond the gate the dunes roll away to the horizon.

events.name: The Dry Well
rumors: Curator Tamsin at the museum would pay a fortune for the Sun Disk.
The Sun King still sits on his throne beneath the sand. Dead, but not finished.
Mummies burn like old paper. Bring fire.
Scorpions the size of oxen nest in the rocks north-east of the oasis.
A sphinx guards a ruined shrine in the south-west. It doesn't ask riddles any more.
The tomb's priests can rot a man where he stands. Keep your cure potions close.

events.name: Notice
events.text: REWARD: for the Sun Disk of the Sun Kings, returned to the Museum of Ashkar. Enquire within. - T.

events.name: Museum of Ashkar
events.text: A sharp-eyed woman looks up from a case of broken pottery. "Curator Tamsin. You have the look of tomb-breakers - good. The Sun Disk lies with the last Sun King, in the tomb west across the Wastes. He did not go quietly into death, and I am told he has not gone quietly since. Bring me the Disk."

events.name: Museum of Ashkar
events.text: Tamsin sets the Disk on black velvet and is silent for a long time. "Thank you. Ashkar will remember the names of the ones who brought back the sun." She presses a heavy purse and a golden scarab into your hands.

events.name: Museum of Ashkar
events.text: The Sun Disk glows in the museum's centre case. Crowds come every day to see it.

events.name: Captain Rashid's Post
events.text: Captain Rashid of the Desert Guard folds his arms. "A scorpion the size of a cart nests north-east of the oasis. It has killed six of my riders. Bring me its stinger."

events.name: Captain Rashid's Post
events.text: Rashid hangs the stinger above his door. "For my riders. The Guard's bounty is yours, and the gems we took from its last victims."

The Archivist of Port Ashkar turns pale at the name. "Isaura. She was our keeper of songs, before the Choir took her. She carries the Belfry Key, and hides where no one goes - in the Tomb of the Sun Kings, out in the Sunscar Wastes."
events.name: The Sealed Archive

events.text: The Archivist: "Isaura is in the Tomb of the Sun Kings. Take the key from her."
events.name: The Sealed Archive

events.text: The Sealed Archive. Scholars copy old songs onto new scrolls.
events.name: The Sealed Archive
The Night Market
events.failText: Empty stalls and furled awnings. The traders of the Night Market only come out after dark (20:00).
